claims.text: The SGD 6.00 no-show fee is chargeable only if all four POL-NS-01 limbs hold together, and limb (b) requires the gps_trace to place the driver inside the pickup geofence at or before the 'arrived' event. The only trace for this trip, EV-GPS-09109, is MISSING: its payload is null, its admissibility status is MISSING with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and its weight_multiplier is 0.0, so under POL-GEN-02 it can carry no fact while its absence is itself citable. There is accordingly not one fix putting the car inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius for the Woodlands MRT private-hire bay, and the driver's own counterparty statement ('the GPS export is unavailable') concedes the gap. Limb (b) is not carried, and the charge fails.

POL-NS-02 deems the driver to have arrived only where the gps_trace contains at least three consecutive fixes, each accurate to 25 m or better, inside the arrival radius (150 m for a TRANSPORT_HUB such as this bay). EV-GPS-09109 is MISSING (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0), so it supplies zero qualifying fixes and the 15 minutes preceding the 21:15:40 cancellation contain no qualifying in-radius fix at all. On the clause's own terms the driver never arrived, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee.

Limb (c) measures the 300 second minimum dwell for a TRANSPORT_HUB from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, expressly not from the driver's 'arrived' tap at 21:10:20. With EV-GPS-09109 MISSING (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0) there is no qualifying fix and therefore no in-geofence interval to measure; the 5.3 minute wait_time_min in the trip record is telemetry of the arrival marker, not the GPS-verified dwell the clause demands. Limb (c) is not established either, so the fee fails independently of limb (b).

The fare_breakdown itemises the cancellation fee at exactly SGD 6.00, the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class figure, which is the greater of the SGD 6.00 zone-class fee and the SGD 4.00 RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee, with payment_status PENDING and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The whole SGD 6.00 is therefore the sum at stake, and the correct rider outcome on this fee is a FULL_REFUND of the entire contested amount rather than any partial measure.

If the Judge instead reads a MISSING trace as leaving the arrival test unrunnable rather than failed, the fee still must not be collected: the sole evidence bearing on the driver's position during the waiting window is EV-GPS-09109, which is MISSING at weight_multiplier 0.0 with issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, so any finding resting on it cannot exceed that weight and cannot reach the 0.70 confidence floor. Escalation under POL-NS-09 holds the disputed SGD 6.00 rather than collecting it, and an escalated fee is not collected, so on either reading the rider is left not carrying the charge.

claims.text: The trip record carries three of the four limbs of the baseline charge under POL-NS-01: limb (a) is met by the driver 'arrived' event at 2026-09-09T21:10:20; limb (d) is met because the trip was terminated by the driver at 21:15:40 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes that limb recognises; and the arrival-to-cancellation interval of 320 seconds (wait_time_min 5.3) stands above the 300-second minimum dwell for a TRANSPORT_HUB pickup. I do not overstate limb (c): its strict measure runs from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, which cannot be computed because no GPS export exists, and 320 seconds is the best interval the record supports.

The driver's account is corroborated by the complete chat log, and the rider's exoneration route under POL-NS-04 is closed: the driver posted 'I am at the private-hire bay' at 21:10:40, twenty seconds after the arrival event, and when the rider wrote 'I am at the bay and cannot see your car' at 21:11:30 the driver replied 'I am here beside the sign' at 21:11:45 — fifteen seconds later, well inside POL-NS-04's 120-second window — so limb (b) of that clause fails and the clause does not apply regardless of the reply's content.

POL-NS-05's false-arrival test cannot be run against the driver, and the rider carries the burden of it: the test matches the arrival timestamp to a GPS fix, and the only GPS artifact, EV-GPS-09109, is MISSING with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT and weight 0.0. I disclose that impairment; no admissible fix places the driver more than 300 m from the pin or travelling at 15 km/h or above, and a trace that does not exist cannot itself prove a false marker.

The rider's central assertion — 'the car was not at the pickup bay' — rests on nothing admissible: the only artifact that could place the driver outside the geofence is the GPS trace, and EV-GPS-09109 is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0). Under POL-GEN-02 a MISSING artifact can carry no fact and its absence is itself citable; absence of a trace is not evidence of absence, so on this record the rider has not proved non-arrival at all.

POL-NS-06 establishes no waiting-period shortfall: the effective in-geofence dwell cannot be computed because EV-GPS-09109 is MISSING (MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0), and the trip record's own 320-second arrival-to-cancellation interval clears the 300-second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09109-01 is also MISSING (MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0). I disclose both impairments; the absent advisory additionally means no kerb restriction, closure or enforcement on the pickup road is recorded, so nothing in the record cuts the dwell down.

The charged fee is exactly the fee the schedule prescribes, so no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect arises to discount it: fee_schedule.resolution_rule makes the chargeable amount the greater of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) — SGD 6.00 — and the fare_breakdown cancellation_fee line is SGD 6.00. The fare artifact is complete at weight 1.0 and cannot be used to impair the charge.

If the charge stands the driver is owed compensation, and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not bite: it requires BOTH limbs and neither trips — driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and 1 divided by completed_trips_30d of 120 is 0.008, far below 0.08 — so the driver is entitled to 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 fee, SGD 4.80, the figure the fare breakdown's own derived driver_compensation publishes.

No repeat-abuse escalation trigger in POL-NS-09 fires on these profiles: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 where limb (d) needs 3 or more, and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0 where limb (c) needs 2 or more disputes between the same pair. I cite only those named counters; the lifetime counters prior_no_show_flags on both profiles are context only under POL-GEN-01 and I do not rely on them.

On a rider-filed dispute, declining to act is a driver outcome: the fare breakdown shows payment_status PENDING and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so under POL-GEN-03 a NO_ACTION disposition leaves the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee standing in full rather than reversing it.

In the alternative, even if the absent GPS trace were treated as decisive against POL-NS-01 limb (b), the record still could not yield the refund the rider seeks: the deciding fact would be carried solely by EV-GPS-09109 at weight 0.0 (MISSING_ARTIFACT), POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at that weight, the 0.70 floor is breached, and POL-NS-09(a) and (e) then require ESCALATE — under which the disputed SGD 6.00 is held rather than collected or refunded. The fee is not returned on any reading of this record.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this dispute cannot be decided on the present record, and the SGD 6.00 no-show fee is placed on hold — neither collected nor refunded — pending human review.

Why the fee cannot be resolved. A no-show fee is chargeable only if all four POL-NS-01 conditions hold together. Limb (b) requires the GPS trace to place the driver inside the pickup geofence at or before the 'arrived' event, and limb (c) requires the 300-second minimum dwell for a TRANSPORT_HUB to be measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, expressly not from the 21:10:20 arrival tap. The only trace for this trip, EV-GPS-09109, is MISSING: its payload is null, its admissibility status is MISSING with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and its weight_multiplier is 0.0. Under POL-GEN-02 a missing artifact carries no fact, and its absence is itself citable.

To the rider: your central assertion — that the car was not at the bay — is not proved on this record, and I cannot order the full refund you seek. POL-NS-02 gives a full refund where a trace exists but contains no qualifying in-radius fix; a trace that does not exist at all is the limiting case of an impaired trace under POL-NS-08(b), not proof of absence. An undecided limb supports neither a charge that needs the clause to hold nor a refund that needs it to fail, so I apply the integrity and escalation clauses instead of reading the empty slot in your favour.

To the driver: your case cannot stand either. Limb (b) is not carried, and the trip record's 320-second arrival-to-cancellation interval (wait_time_min 5.3) is telemetry of the arrival marker, not the GPS-verified dwell limb (c) demands. Your own counterparty statement concedes that 'the GPS export is unavailable.'

The chat log (EV-CHAT-09109, weight 1.0) is complete and does close the rider's POL-NS-04 route — the driver replied 'I am here beside the sign' at 21:11:45, fifteen seconds after the rider's 21:11:30 message, inside the 120-second window — but it records only that the parties said these things; it does not establish the driver's physical position and so cannot carry the deciding fact. The fare breakdown (EV-FARE-09109, weight 1.0) shows the SGD 6.00 line is exactly the schedule figure (the greater of the SGD 6.00 TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee and the SGD 4.00 RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee), so no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect arises. The missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-09109-01, weight 0.0) simply makes POL-NS-06 limb (i) unavailable and excuses no one.

Escalation. The sole evidence for the deciding fact — the driver's position during the waiting window — is EV-GPS-09109, which is impaired (absent). Under POL-NS-08 the ruling may not exceed PARTIAL_REFUND, and the case escalates under POL-NS-09(e). Confidence is in any event capped at the 0.0 weight of the only artifact that could carry that fact, well below the 0.70 floor, which independently triggers POL-NS-09(a). Driver compensation under POL-NS-07 is therefore not payable: it presupposes a charge that stands, and here the charge neither stands nor fails. (For completeness, the anti-farming check would not have bitten anyway: no_show_terminations_30d is 1, and 1/120 = 0.008.)

Open question for the reviewer: obtain a driver-device or platform GPS export for the waiting window (or equivalent verified position data) and determine whether the driver was inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius for at least 300 continuous seconds before the 21:15:40 cancellation, and if not, whether the driver was stationary within 400 m of the pin (POL-NS-03). The disputed SGD 6.00 is held meanwhile.

No referral is issued: none of the clauses that produce one fires — no false-arrival marker can be established against the absent trace under POL-NS-05, and POL-NS-07's anti-farming branch does not trip.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this case cannot be decided on this record and goes to a human reviewer. The SGD 6.00 no-show fee is HELD — not collected and not refunded — while that review is pending.

Why it cannot be decided. The fee is chargeable only if all four conditions in POL-NS-01 hold. Two of them — limb (b), the driver inside the pickup geofence at the arrival event, and limb (c), a continuous dwell of at least 300 seconds for a TRANSPORT_HUB measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, and expressly NOT from the driver's arrived tap — can only be established by the GPS trace. EV-GPS-09109 is MISSING: its payload is null, its status is MISSING with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and its weight_multiplier is 0.0, so it carries no fix at all. POL-NS-02 says a trace too sparse to yield three consecutive in-radius fixes is impaired rather than proof that the driver never came; a trace that does not exist is the limiting case. The arrival test therefore cannot be run, and limb (b) is UNDECIDED — neither satisfied nor failed. An undecided limb supports neither outcome: the rider cannot have a refund that needs the limb to fail, and the driver cannot keep a fee that needs the limb to hold. The single artifact that could decide the case is the one that is absent, so POL-NS-09(e) escalates; and because confidence is capped at that missing trace's weight of 0.0, below the platform floor of 0.70, POL-NS-09(a) escalates as well. No referral is issued: no clause in this category produces one on these facts.

The rider's case. I accept that the whole SGD 6.00 is at stake and that the fare line reconciles with the schedule (the greater of the SGD 6.00 TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee and the SGD 4.00 RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee — SGD 6.00, produced by the zone-class dimension), and that no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect discounts it. I do NOT accept the rider's central step: that the absence of a trace means the car was not at the bay. An absent instrument is not evidence of absence, and POL-NS-02's own terms reserve that conclusion for a trace that was read and showed no qualifying fix. The limb (c) and POL-GEN-03 full-refund claims fall with it — an untested limb cannot carry a refund, and the rider's own alternative (escalation, fee held) is the outcome reached.

The driver's case. I accept that the trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event and a termination with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, and that the 320-second arrival-to-cancellation interval would clear the minimum if that were the clause's measure. I accept that the rider's POL-NS-04 exoneration is closed — the driver replied ('I am here beside the sign') 15 seconds after the rider's message, well inside the 120-second window. I accept that the false-arrival test under POL-NS-05 cannot run without a trace. I accept that the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not bite (no_show_terminations_30d is 1, not 4 or more, and 1/120 = 0.008, not above 0.08), so the driver would be entitled to SGD 4.80 if the fee were established. But limb (b) is not established, so on this record the fee does not stand and no compensation can issue. The profile counters relied on are the ones POL-GEN-01 names for POL-NS-07 and POL-NS-09; the lifetime prior_no_show_flags on both profiles are context only and were not used as a ground.

ruling.explanation:
Rider — your complaint is that the car was not at the bay, and the record as it stands cannot show that it was: POL-NS-01 limb (b) needs the GPS trace to place the driver inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius at or before the arrival event, and limb (c) needs a 300-second dwell measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the driver's tap. Neither can be shown, because the only trace for this trip, EV-GPS-09109, is MISSING (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0). But that absence is not proof the driver was elsewhere. POL-GEN-02 says a missing artifact carries no fact while its absence is itself citable, and POL-NS-02's own drafting note says a trace too sparse to yield three consecutive in-radius fixes is impaired rather than proof of absence. So the arrival and dwell limbs are UNDECIDED, not failed, and an undecided limb supports neither a refund that needs the clause to fail nor a charge that needs it to hold. Your request for the whole SGD 6.00 back (POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02) is therefore not granted on this record, and your alternative argument is the one that governs: escalation holds the fee rather than collecting it.

Driver — your fee is not upheld today either, and the SGD 4.80 you claim is not payable. Your arrived tap at 21:10:20 and the trip record's 5.3-minute wait satisfy POL-NS-01 limb (a) and go to limb (d) (driver-terminated with RIDER_NO_SHOW), and the 320-second arrival-to-cancellation interval clears the 300-second minimum — but that interval is not the GPS-verified in-geofence dwell limb (c) demands, and the trace that would prove both limb (b) and limb (c) does not exist. You are right that POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: you replied 'I am here beside the sign' 15 seconds after the rider's 21:11:30 message, inside the 120-second window, so that clause is out on limb (b). You are right that POL-NS-05's false-arrival test cannot be run without a fix and that no false-arrival finding is made, that the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09109-01 is also MISSING (MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0) so no kerb-restriction accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) or shortfall under POL-NS-06 is established, that the SGD 6.00 line reconciles with fee_schedule.resolution_rule (greater of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee SGD 6.00 and the RYDE_X tier fee SGD 4.00) so no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect arises, that the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not bite (no_show_terminations_30d 1, below 4, and 1/120 = 0.008, below 0.08), and that the POL-NS-09(c) and (d) repeat-abuse triggers do not fire (both counterparty counters 0, no_show_disputes_30d 0). But your compensation claim fails for a prior reason: POL-NS-07 requires POL-NS-01 to be satisfied in full, and it is not. Your own statement — you were at the bay for the full waiting period but the GPS export is unavailable — is evidence, and it corroborates the gap, but it cannot substitute for the test the clause reads. Your conclusion that the charge simply stands (POL-GEN-03 NO_ACTION) is rejected: the arrival limb is undecided and the sole evidence for it is impaired, so nothing on this record supports leaving the fee in place any more than it supports refunding it. (Your claim that mentions prior_no_show_flags does so only to say it is context-only and is not relied on; that is correct and nothing turns on it.)

Why this escalates rather than being decided: the sole evidence for the deciding fact — the driver's position inside the pickup geofence and how long he held it — is EV-GPS-09109, which is missing and is impaired under POL-NS-08(b) (fewer than six fixes across the waiting window, and no rider_track). POL-NS-08 and POL-NS-09(e) then require the case to go to a human reviewer, and the POL-GEN-02(2) confidence cap is the 0.0 weight of that artifact — below the platform floor of 0.70 stated in POL-NS-09(a) and the policy's confidence_floor. The chat log and trip record are consistent with a genuine wait and with a rider who was present, but because the GPS test admitted no reading at all, those accounts stand in for the test rather than bridging it, and they neither lift the cap nor stop the impaired artifact being the only evidence. The agent version is SYSTEM, so a few passages above didn't render. The escalation is terminal for the automated pipeline: no money moves, and the disputed SGD 6.00 is on hold rather than collected or refunded.

Open question for the reviewer (POL-NS-09): whether the driver actually entered and held the Woodlands MRT private-hire bay during the waiting window on 2026-09-09, and if so for how long. The reviewer should weigh the driver's statement, the trip record's arrival tap and 5.3-minute wait, and the chat sequence (driver 'I am at the private-hire bay' 21:10:40; rider 'I am at the bay and cannot see your car' 21:11:30; driver 'I am here beside the sign' 21:11:45), and obtain the missing GPS export if it can be recovered. What the record does establish. The trip record (EV-TRIP-09109, complete, weight 1.0) carries a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-09-09T21:10:20 and a driver termination at 21:15:40 coded RIDER_NO_SHOW, so POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (d) are met. The chat log (EV-CHAT-09109, complete, weight 1.0) is complete against trip_record.chat_message_count and shows the driver answered the rider's 'I cannot see your car' 15 seconds later ('I am here beside the sign'), inside POL-NS-04's 120-second window — so limb (b) of POL-NS-04 fails and the rider is not exonerated under that clause, whatever the reply said.

What is missing, and why it matters. POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c) are read from the GPS trace alone — the geofence test under POL-NS-02, and the dwell test measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the 'arrived' tap. The only GPS artifact, EV-GPS-09109, is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0, no payload), so it can carry no fact and supplies zero in-geofence fixes for the 15 minutes before the 21:15:40 cancellation. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09109-01 is likewise MISSING (MISSING_ARTIFACT, 0.0), so no POL-NS-06(i) accumulation across intervals is available either.

To the rider: your full-refund route does not succeed. A trace that does not exist is not a trace that 'contains no qualifying in-radius fix'; the category's own note treats an unusable trace as impaired under POL-NS-08(b) rather than as proof of absence, and absence of evidence is not evidence of absence. Limb (b) is therefore UNDECIDED, not failed, and the same is true of the dwell under limb (c). The driver's counterparty statement is evidence and concedes only that the export is unavailable — it carries no weight and cannot stand in for the GPS test. Nothing on this record returns the SGD 6.00 to you.

To the driver: the charge does not stand on this record either. POL-NS-01 requires all four limbs, and limbs (b) and (c) depend on the export you say is unavailable; the 320-second arrival-to-cancellation interval is the arrival marker's own telemetry, not the GPS-verified dwell the clause demands. There is accordingly no established chargeable fee, and no basis for the SGD 4.80 you seek under POL-NS-07 while the fee is unresolved. The anti-farming limb does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d = 1, below 4, and 1/120 = 0.008, below 0.08), and neither POL-NS-09(c) nor (d) fires on the two profiles. NO_ACTION is not available: escalation replaces any money outcome.

Why escalation. The sole evidence that could carry the deciding fact — where the car actually was during the waiting window — is EV-GPS-09109, and it is impaired/absent. POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at that artifact's 0.0 weight, below the 0.70 platform floor; the bundle mean (about 0.71) is context only and is not the cap. POL-NS-08 and POL-NS-09(a) and (e) therefore require escalation, and POL-NS-09 is terminal.

For the human reviewer — the open question to settle: obtain the driver-device or platform GPS export for the waiting window on 2026-09-09 and determine (1) whether the driver entered the Woodlands MRT private-hire bay geofence (150 m arrival radius, TRANSPORT_HUB) at or before 21:10:20 on at least three consecutive fixes accurate to 25 m or better, and (2) if so, whether he then held position for a continuous 300-second dwell measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix. Only that record can decide whether the SGD 6.00 is chargeable.
